title: Rees-algebra bounds for the cohomology of the I^nF on a proper scheme
statement: Let $A$ be a Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], $I\subseteq A$ an ideal, $f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ a proper morphism [def-weil-proper-morphism], $\mathcal I=I\mathcal O_X\subseteq\mathcal O_X$ the image of $f^*\widetilde I\to f^*\mathcal O_{\operatorname{Spec}A}\to\mathcal O_X$ [def-nagata-extended-ideal], and $\mathcal F$ a coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module [pqf-def-coherent]. Put $\mathcal I^0\mathcal F=\mathcal F$ and, for $n\ge1$, let $\mathcal I^n\mathcal F\subseteq\mathcal F$ be as in [def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module] (0), so that $\mathcal I^k\mathcal F\subseteq\mathcal I^n\mathcal F$ for $k\ge n\ge0$. Fix $q\ge0$, write $M_n=H^q(X,\mathcal I^n\mathcal F)$ for $n\ge0$ (sheaf cohomology [pqf-def-cohomology]; an $A$-module, $a\in A$ acting through the image of $a$ in $\Gamma(X,\mathcal O_X)$), and for $k\ge n\ge0$ let $\mu_{k,n}:M_k\to M_n$ be the map induced by the inclusion $\mathcal I^k\mathcal F\subseteq\mathcal I^n\mathcal F$. Then there is an integer $c\ge0$ such that (a) for all $n,m\ge0$ with $n+m\ge c$ one has $\mu_{n+m,n}(M_{n+m})\subseteq I^{m-e}M_n$, where $e=\max(0,c-n)$; and (b) for all $n\ge c$ one has $\operatorname{Ker}(\mu_{n,0})=\operatorname{Ker}(\mu_{n,n-c})$.

source.place: Cohomology of Schemes, Lemma 02OA (lemma-cohomology-powers-ideal-application, line 5452), parts (2) and (3), with its proof (lines 5491-5546: the graded module M = (+)_n H^p(X, I^n F) is finite over the Rees algebra B = (+)_n I^n by Lemma 02O8, lemma-cohomology-powers-ideal-times-F, line 5379; the kernel K = (+)_n Ker(M_n -> M_0) is a graded B-submodule, finite since B is Noetherian). Stacks writes I^nF for the image of f^*(I^n)~ (x) F -> F; this equals (I O_X)^n F as used here, since the image of f^*(I^n)~ in O_X is (I O_X)^n (on an affine open Spec B of X both are I^nB). Stacks' proof of (3) takes c = max of the degrees of generators of K; one c serves (a) and (b) together because both conclusions remain true when c is enlarged (take the maximum of the two). Tags verified in tags/tags: 02OA, 02O8.
